title: Session 14: Deploying Web Applications and Services

questions.questionText: Azure App Service Web apps is a service used to host:
options: Web applications, REST APIs, and mobile backends
questions.correctAnswer: Web applications, REST APIs, and mobile backends
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) Web applications, REST APIs, and mobile backends.

questions.questionText: Which languages can be used to develop Azure App Service Web apps?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) C#, Java, PHP, Ruby, Python.

questions.questionText: Which are the three main benefits of Azure App Services?
options: High-productivity development, fully-managed platform, enterprise-grade apps
Low cost, no security, manual scaling
Only hosting, only billing, only logging
questions.correctAnswer: High-productivity development, fully-managed platform, enterprise-grade apps
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) High-productivity development, fully-managed platform, enterprise-grade apps.

questions.questionText: High-productivity development in App Services includes:
options: Debugging live-site, continuous integration, and Visual Studio IDE
questions.correctAnswer: Debugging live-site, continuous integration, and Visual Studio IDE
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) Debugging live-site, continuous integration, and Visual Studio IDE.

questions.questionText: In a fully-managed platform, App Services handles:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) Infrastructure maintenance and load balancing.

questions.questionText: Which capabilities are easier with App Service's managed platform?
options: Adding SSL certificates, SSO, custom domains, identity integration
questions.correctAnswer: Adding SSL certificates, SSO, custom domains, identity integration
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) Adding SSL certificates, SSO, custom domains, identity integration.

questions.questionText: Enterprise-grade apps in App Services benefit from:
options: Global datacenter network, security, and compliance
questions.correctAnswer: Global datacenter network, security, and compliance
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) Global datacenter network, security, and compliance.

questions.questionText: Which service is integrated with App Service to help secure apps?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) Azure Active Directory.

questions.questionText: Web apps in Azure App Service are similar to the earlier:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) Azure Websites.

questions.questionText: Web apps key features include:
options: Built-in autoscale, load balancing, and high availability with auto-patching
questions.correctAnswer: Built-in autoscale, load balancing, and high availability with auto-patching
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) Built-in autoscale, load balancing, and high availability with auto-patching.

questions.questionText: Which of the following templates is available for Web apps?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) WordPress, Umbraco, Joomla, Drupal.

questions.questionText: The compute resources that run Web apps are determined by the:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) App Service plan.

questions.questionText: Mobile Apps in Azure App Service provide:
options: A custom backend for mobile platforms such as iOS, Windows, Android, Cordova, Xamarin
questions.correctAnswer: A custom backend for mobile platforms such as iOS, Windows, Android, Cordova, Xamarin
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) A custom backend for mobile platforms such as iOS, Windows, Android, Cordova, Xamarin.

questions.questionText: Which feature of Mobile Apps lets an app work offline?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) Native sync experience.

questions.questionText: Mobile Apps support social integration with:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) Facebook, Twitter, and Google.

questions.questionText: Mobile Apps support long-running background tasks using:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) WebJobs.

questions.questionText: Logic Apps in Azure App Service allow users to:
options: Automate the execution of processes across commercial services, consumers, and on-premises custom APIs
questions.correctAnswer: Automate the execution of processes across commercial services, consumers, and on-premises custom APIs
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) Automate the execution of processes across commercial services, consumers, and on-premises custom APIs.

questions.questionText: Which is a key feature of Logic Apps in App Service?
options: Creating business processes and workflows visually
questions.correctAnswer: Creating business processes and workflows visually
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) Creating business processes and workflows visually.

questions.questionText: API Apps are used for:
options: Building, consuming, and distributing APIs in the cloud and on-premises
questions.correctAnswer: Building, consuming, and distributing APIs in the cloud and on-premises
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) Building, consuming, and distributing APIs in the cloud and on-premises.

questions.questionText: API Apps secure APIs using:
options: Single Sign-On, Active Directory, and OAuth
questions.correctAnswer: Single Sign-On, Active Directory, and OAuth
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) Single Sign-On, Active Directory, and OAuth.

questions.questionText: An App Service plan provides resources that are similar to:
options: A server farm in traditional Web hosting
questions.correctAnswer: A server farm in traditional Web hosting
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) A server farm in traditional Web hosting.

questions.questionText: Each App Service plan defines which of the following?
options: Region, number of VM instances, VM instance size, and pricing tier
questions.correctAnswer: Region, number of VM instances, VM instance size, and pricing tier
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) Region, number of VM instances, VM instance size, and pricing tier.

questions.questionText: Which pricing tiers are listed for App Service plans?
options: Free, Shared, Basic, Standard, Premium, PremiumV2, Isolated, Consumption
questions.correctAnswer: Free, Shared, Basic, Standard, Premium, PremiumV2, Isolated, Consumption
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) Free, Shared, Basic, Standard, Premium, PremiumV2, Isolated, Consumption.

questions.questionText: Which are the shared compute tiers?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) Free and Shared.

questions.questionText: In shared compute tiers, apps:
options: Run on the same Azure VM as other customers' apps and cannot scale out
questions.correctAnswer: Run on the same Azure VM as other customers' apps and cannot scale out
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) Run on the same Azure VM as other customers' apps and cannot scale out.

questions.questionText: Which are the dedicated compute tiers?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) Basic, Standard, Premium, and PremiumV2.

questions.questionText: In dedicated compute tiers, resources are shared only among:
options: Apps in the same App Service plan
questions.correctAnswer: Apps in the same App Service plan
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) Apps in the same App Service plan.

questions.questionText: The Isolated tier runs apps on:
options: Dedicated Azure VMs on dedicated Azure Virtual Networks
questions.correctAnswer: Dedicated Azure VMs on dedicated Azure Virtual Networks
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) Dedicated Azure VMs on dedicated Azure Virtual Networks.

questions.questionText: The Consumption tier:
options: Dynamically scales functions depending on workload
questions.correctAnswer: Dynamically scales functions depending on workload
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) Dynamically scales functions depending on workload.

questions.questionText: Billing for App Service plans is done:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) On a per-second basis.

questions.questionText: Which plans are suitable for production workloads on dedicated VMs?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) Basic, Standard, and Premium.

questions.questionText: For apps that require a private dedicated Azure environment and secure connection to on-premises network, which plan is suitable?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) Isolated.

questions.questionText: To estimate the price of Azure products, a company should use:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) The online pricing calculator.

questions.questionText: Azure App Service is described as a fully managed:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) Platform as a Service (PaaS).

questions.questionText: Azure App Service incorporates which previous services into a single service?
options: Mobile Services, Azure Websites, and BizTalk Services
questions.correctAnswer: Mobile Services, Azure Websites, and BizTalk Services
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) Mobile Services, Azure Websites, and BizTalk Services.

questions.questionText: In the portal, which apps are listed under the Web menu when creating a resource?
options: Web App, API App, Logic App
questions.correctAnswer: Web App, API App, Logic App
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) Web App, API App, Logic App.

questions.questionText: In the portal, which app is listed under the Mobile menu?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) Mobile App.

questions.questionText: When creating an ASP.NET Web app for Azure deployment in the walkthrough, authentication is set to:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) No Authentication.

questions.questionText: Which Visual Studio menu option is used to run the Web app locally without debugging?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) Debug > Start without Debugging.

questions.questionText: How is the publish wizard launched in Solution Explorer?
options: Right-click the project and select Publish
questions.correctAnswer: Right-click the project and select Publish
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) Right-click the project and select Publish.

questions.questionText: Which publish target is selected to deploy to Azure Web Apps?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) App Service.

questions.questionText: After a successful deployment of the Web app, the developer has:
options: A resource group containing an App Service plan and an Azure Web app with a deployed application
questions.correctAnswer: A resource group containing an App Service plan and an Azure Web app with a deployed application
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) A resource group containing an App Service plan and an Azure Web app with a deployed application.

questions.questionText: WCF Data Services were formerly known as:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) ADO.NET Data Services.

questions.questionText: OData is a:
options: REST-based protocol that allows CRUD operations on resources through URLs
questions.correctAnswer: REST-based protocol that allows CRUD operations on resources through URLs
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) REST-based protocol that allows CRUD operations on resources through URLs.

questions.questionText: WCF Data Services return results in which formats?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) XML-based Atom and JSON.

questions.questionText: OData uses which model of the Entity Framework to expose resources as related entities?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) Entity Data Model.

questions.questionText: CRUD operations in OData use which standard HTTP methods?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) GET, PUT, POST, DELETE.

questions.questionText: In the WCF Data Service walkthrough, the ASP.NET Web app is named:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) WCFDataServiceDemo.

questions.questionText: Which project template is selected for the WCFDataServiceDemo app?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) Empty project.

questions.questionText: Which WCF Data Service item name is created in the walkthrough?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) ProductsWcfDataService.svc.

questions.questionText: In Visual Studio 2017, the WCF Data Service template:
options: Is not seen by default and must be added by installing an extension
Is available only in Visual Studio 6
questions.correctAnswer: Is not seen by default and must be added by installing an extension
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) Is not seen by default and must be added by installing an extension.

questions.questionText: Which template is used to create a data model from an existing database in the walkthrough?
options: ADO.NET Entity Data Model (EF Designer from database)
questions.correctAnswer: ADO.NET Entity Data Model (EF Designer from database)
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) ADO.NET Entity Data Model (EF Designer from database).

questions.questionText: In ProductsWcfDataService.svc.cs, which placeholder is replaced with the name of the entity model?
options: <TODO: put your data source class name here>
questions.correctAnswer: <TODO: put your data source class name here>
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) <TODO: put your data source class name here>.

questions.questionText: Which dialog is used to add a reference to the data service address?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) Add Service Reference.

questions.questionText: Which option is selected to deploy the WCF data service to Azure in the walkthrough?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) Publish Azure Application.
